examples.en: The company has won several awards for excellence in customer service.

translations.zh-TW: 這家公司因卓越的客戶服務而屢獲殊榮。

examples.en: Our department strives for excellence in every project we deliver.

translations.zh-TW: 我們部門在每個交付專案上都力求卓越。

examples.en: The excellences of this new software are its speed and intuitive design.

translations.zh-TW: 這套新軟體的優點在於速度與直覺式的設計。

translations.definition: adv. 排他地、專門地、僅僅

examples.en: This meeting room is reserved exclusively for senior managers.

translations.zh-TW: 這間會議室專門保留給資深經理使用。

examples.en: The boutique sells exclusively imported Italian leather goods.

translations.zh-TW: 這家精品店只販售進口的義大利皮革製品。

examples.en: She was hired almost exclusively because of her fluent Japanese.

translations.zh-TW: 她幾乎完全是因為流利的日語而被錄用。

translations.definition: n. 告別、歡送會  interj. 再會、再見

examples.en: The whole team gathered to give our retiring manager a warm farewell.

translations.zh-TW: 整個團隊齊聚一堂，為即將退休的經理送上溫暖的告別。

examples.en: Several touching farewells were exchanged at her last day in the office.

translations.zh-TW: 她在辦公室的最後一天，大家彼此交換了幾段感人的道別。

examples.en: Farewell, and thank you for your years of dedicated service to this firm.

translations.zh-TW: 再會了，感謝您多年來對本公司盡心盡力的服務。

translations.definition: n. 疲勞、疲倦  v. 使疲勞、使心力交瘁

examples.en: Driver fatigue is one of the leading causes of highway accidents.

translations.zh-TW: 駕駛疲勞是高速公路事故的主要成因之一。

examples.en: A string of all-nighters fatigued the entire development team before the launch.

translations.zh-TW: 一連串的熬夜在產品上線前讓整個開發團隊疲憊不堪。

examples.en: Reviewing endless spreadsheets can be fatiguing even for the most experienced auditors.

translations.zh-TW: 即使對最有經驗的稽核員來說，審閱無盡的試算表也令人費神疲憊。

translations.definition: adj. 財政的、會計的、國庫的

examples.en: The government posted a fiscal surplus for the second consecutive quarter.

translations.zh-TW: 政府連續第二季錄得財政盈餘。

examples.en: Our fiscal year ends in March, so the budget review is held every February.

translations.zh-TW: 我們的會計年度在三月底結束，因此預算審查在每年二月舉行。

examples.en: The central bank's fiscal policy adjustments helped stabilize the currency.

translations.zh-TW: 央行的財政政策調整協助穩定了貨幣。

translations.definition: n. 車隊、船隊、機隊  adj. 快速的、敏捷的  v. 飛逝、掠過

examples.en: The logistics company expanded its delivery fleet to meet rising demand.

translations.zh-TW: 這家物流公司擴充了送貨車隊以應付不斷攀升的需求。

examples.en: The cruise line operates two fleets that sail between Asia and Australia.

translations.zh-TW: 這家郵輪公司營運兩支船隊，往返於亞洲與澳洲之間。

examples.en: A fleeting smile crossed her face when she saw the outstanding quarterly results.

translations.zh-TW: 看到亮眼的季度業績時，她臉上一閃而過一抹微笑。

translations.definition: n. 霧、迷惑  v. 籠罩霧氣、使模糊、使困惑

examples.en: Dense fog delayed all morning flights at the international airport.

translations.zh-TW: 濃霧導致國際機場所有早班航班延誤。

examples.en: Heavy fogs over the harbor forced the cargo ships to anchor offshore overnight.

translations.zh-TW: 港灣上空的濃霧迫使貨輪在離岸處下錨過夜。

examples.en: The complicated contract terms fogged our understanding of the renewal conditions.

translations.zh-TW: 複雜的合約條款讓我們對續約條件感到困惑。

examples.en: The two companies formally announced their merger at a press conference yesterday.

translations.zh-TW: 兩家公司昨天在記者會上正式宣布合併。

examples.en: Candidates must be formally dressed when attending the panel interview.

translations.zh-TW: 應徵者出席小組面試時必須穿著正式服裝。

examples.en: The complaint was formally filed with the labor board last Friday afternoon.

translations.zh-TW: 申訴案已於上週五下午向勞工局正式提出。

translations.definition: n. 克（重量單位）、鷹嘴豆

examples.en: Each serving contains exactly 25 grams of protein and only 5 grams of sugar.

translations.zh-TW: 每份含有精確的 25 克蛋白質與僅 5 克糖分。

examples.en: The jeweler weighed the gold necklace on a scale accurate to a tenth of a gram.

translations.zh-TW: 珠寶商用精確到零點一克的秤來稱量這條金項鍊。

examples.en: Air freight rates for express parcels are often quoted per gram over a base weight.

translations.zh-TW: 快遞包裹的空運費率通常以每克計價並設定基礎重量。

examples.en: Every new employee receives a handbook explaining our internal policies.

translations.zh-TW: 每位新進員工都會收到一本說明公司內部規範的手冊。

examples.en: The supervisor updated the employee handbooks to reflect the latest safety regulations.

translations.zh-TW: 主管更新了員工手冊，以反映最新的安全規範。

examples.en: Please consult the handbook before submitting travel and expense reimbursement claims.

translations.zh-TW: 提交差旅與費用報銷申請前，請先查閱手冊。
